name: 🏡 ALADIA
desc:
ALADIA is a fast paced third person PvP shooter built for competitive players. Out aim, out move, and outplay your enemies in intense duels, team battles, and clan wars.

⚔️ 1v1 Duels, Team Fights, and Clan Wars
🏆 Rank up and prove your skill in every match
🎨 Unlock and collect unique weapon skins
👥 Team up with your clan and fight for dominance
🔥 Fast, skill based combat with competitive action

🎮 Supports PC, Mobile, and Controller.

👍 Like & Favorite the game for more updates!
